name: compound_scaffold_feature
description: Full-stack feature scaffold: create a GitHub branch, generate Neon DB branch, scaffold API routes and UI components, and open a draft PR — all in one command

feature_name.description: Feature name in kebab-case e.g. customer-portal

create_db_branch.description: Also create a matching Neon DB branch

project_id.description: Neon project ID (required if create_db_branch is true)

name: compound_safe_deploy
description: Deploy to Vercel production with automated pre-flight checks: run tests, verify env vars, confirm DB migrations are applied, and roll back automatically on failure

name: compound_onboard_saas_customer
description: Onboard a new SaaS customer: create Stripe customer + subscription, provision database schema/tenant, send welcome email via Resend, and set up any required Neon branches or Upstash namespaces

stripe_price_id.description: Stripe Price ID for the subscription

neon_project_id.description: Neon project to provision tenant schema in

name: compound_incident_response
description: Automated incident response: check Vercel/Fly deployment health, query Neon for recent errors, pull Sentry issues, draft a Slack incident message, and optionally roll back the last deployment

auto_rollback.description: Automatically roll back if errors exceed threshold

name: compound_neon_safe_migration
description: Safe database migration workflow: create a test branch, apply migration SQL, run validation queries, check for breaking changes, then apply to main and delete test branch

migration_sql.description: SQL to run as the migration

validation_sql.description: Optional SQL to verify the migration succeeded

apply_to_main.description: Apply to main branch after successful test

name: compound_git_commit_push
description: Stage all changes (or specified files), write a conventional commit message, push the branch, and optionally open a GitHub PR with a generated description

message.description: Commit message (conventional commit format preferred e.g. 'feat: add customer dashboard')

files.description: Specific files to stage (defaults to all changed files)

branch.description: Branch to push to (defaults to current branch)

open_pr.description: Open a GitHub PR after pushing

name: compound_project_health_check
description: Full project health report: check Vercel deployment status, Neon DB connection and query performance, Upstash Redis hit rate, Fly.io app health, and Sentry error counts in one sweep

name: compound_send_dispatch_notification
description: Send a job/dispatch notification across multiple channels: Resend email, Twilio SMS, and update the Neon database record — used for YardSync dispatch alerts

job_id.description: Job or dispatch ID to notify about

name: compound_generate_and_embed
description: Generate OpenAI embeddings for one or more texts and upsert them into Qdrant as vectors — used for semantic search, RAG pipelines, and AI-powered features

payloads.description: Metadata payloads to store alongside each vector (parallel array with texts)

name: compound_semantic_search
description: Embed a query with OpenAI and search Qdrant for the most semantically similar results — one-shot RAG retrieval for AI features

filter.description: Optional Qdrant filter on payload fields

name: compound_analytics_snapshot
description: Pull a cross-platform analytics snapshot: Neon query counts, Vercel traffic, Upstash Redis ops, Stripe MRR, and Resend email stats — formatted as a daily briefing
